topic: Ordering Dinner with a Nut Allergy

script.title: A SAFE DINNER
script.scene_zh: 泰式餐廳 · 過敏點餐
script.story_hook: One allergy note changes the whole dinner order.
script.intro_zh: 一張過敏備註，改變整份晚餐的點法。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to a Thai restaurant tonight. Listen for polite safety questions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到今晚的泰式餐廳。留意有禮的安全提問。
script.outro: And that's dining out with an allergy, handled. Listen once more, then repeat.
script.outro_zh: 過敏體質也能安心外食。再聽一遍，接著跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice each sentence out loud now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們把每句大聲練習一次。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged woman in her late forties with a short silver-gray pixie cut, a deep blue linen button shirt, small gold earrings, reading glasses on a beaded chain, and a medium build
script.char_b_description: an eager young man in his early twenties with neat short brown hair, a crisp white shirt with rolled sleeves, a black waiter waist apron, a silver tie clip, and a lean tall build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I need to tell you something first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi aɪ nid tə tɛl ju ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，我想先跟你說一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. How can I help tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs haʊ kən aɪ hɛlp təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 當然。今晚有什麼可以幫忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a serious peanut allergy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈsɪɹiəs ˈpinʌt ˈælɚdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 我有嚴重的花生過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I'll tell the kitchen right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt aɫ tɛl ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɹaɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，我馬上通知廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Nothing deadly, but I get very sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈdɛdli bʌt aɪ ɡɛt ˈvɛɹi sɪk/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。不致命，但我會很不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Sauces are usually the tricky part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd ˈsɔsɪz ɑɹ ˈjuʒəwəli ðə ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。醬汁通常是最容易出問題的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. Does the green curry have peanuts?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli dʌz ðə ɡɹin ˈkɜɹi hæv ˈpinʌts/
dialogue.zh: 就是這點。綠咖哩裡有花生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The paste has some, um, ground peanuts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə peɪst hæv sʌm ʌm ɡɹaʊnd ˈpinʌts/
dialogue.zh: 咖哩醬裡有，嗯，磨碎的花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, good to know, I loved that dish.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ɡʊd tə noʊ aɪ lʌvd ðæt dɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，知道了，我很愛那道菜耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red curry has no peanuts, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɹɛd ˈkɜɹi hæz noʊ ˈpinʌts aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我記得紅咖哩裡沒有花生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Think? Can you double check with the chef?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪŋk kən ju ˈdʌbəl tʃɛk wɪð ðə ʃɛf/
dialogue.zh: 記得？可以跟主廚再確認一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, I'll ask right now, one moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌæbsəˈlutli aɫ æsk ɹaɪt naʊ wʌn ˈmoʊmənt/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，我現在就去問，請稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush, I'll look at the menu again.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɹʌʃ aɫ lʊk æt ðə ˈmɛnju əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不用急，我再看一下菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry for the wait, the chef checked the red curry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi fɚ ðə weɪt ðə ʃɛf tʃɛkt ðə ɹɛd ˈkɜɹi/
dialogue.zh: 讓你久等了，主廚查過紅咖哩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the answer? Peanut free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ˈænsɚ ˈpinʌt fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 結果呢？沒有花生？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peanut free, but it's made in the same wok.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpinʌt fɹi bʌt ɪs meɪd ɪn ðə seɪm wɑk/
dialogue.zh: 沒有花生，不過是用同一口炒鍋煮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, is a shared wok safe for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪz ə ʃɛɹd wɑk seɪf fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，共用的炒鍋對我真的安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says he'll wash it and use fresh oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz hil wɑʃ ɪt ænd juz fɹɛʃ ɔɪl/
dialogue.zh: 他說會把鍋子洗過，再換新油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds careful enough for me, great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈkɛɹfəl ɪˈnʌf fɚ mi ɡɹeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣我就放心了，太好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can write it down at the register for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kən ɹaɪt ɪt daʊn æt ðə ˈɹɛdʒɪstɚ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以在收銀台幫你寫下備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, then future orders get easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ðɛn ˈfjutʃɚ ˈɔɹdɚz ɡɛt ˈizɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩你了，之後的點餐就會輕鬆很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done deal. Anything else you'd like to avoid?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn dil ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls jud laɪk tə əˈvɔɪd/
dialogue.zh: 成交。還有別的不能碰的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tree nuts too, so almonds and cashews.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹi nʌts tu soʊ ˈɑməndz ænd kæˈʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 樹堅果也不行，杏仁和腰果都不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, the salad has almond slices, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ðə ˈsælæd hæz ˈɑmənd ˈslaɪsɪz ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，沙拉上面有杏仁片，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I saw that, can they come off?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ sɔ ðæt kən ðeɪ kʌm ˈɔf/
dialogue.zh: 對，我看到了，可以拿掉它們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy, no almonds, and check the dressing too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizɪ noʊ ˈɑməndz ænd tʃɛk ðə ˈdɹɛsɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 很容易，杏仁拿掉，醬汁也一併確認？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the dressing nutty at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈdɹɛsɪŋ ˈnʌɾi ət ˈɔl/
dialogue.zh: 醬汁裡會帶一點堅果味嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's lemon, but I'll confirm that as well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈlɛmən bʌt aɫ kənˈfɝm ðæt æz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 是檸檬醬，不過我也順便確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're being so thorough, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈbiɪŋ soʊ ˈθɜɹo θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你真是太仔細了，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my job, and honestly my sister has one too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ dʒɑb ænd ˈɑnəstli maɪ ˈsɪstɚ hæz wʌn tu/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的工作，老實說我姊姊也有過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, then you really get it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðɛn ju ˈɹɪli ɡɛt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那你真的懂這種感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do. So, the red curry, anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du soʊ ðə ɹɛd ˈkɜɹi ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 我懂。那麼紅咖哩之外，還想點別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mango sticky rice, is that safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmæŋɡoʊ ˈstɪki ɹaɪs ɪz ðæt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 芒果糯飯那道甜點安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coconut milk, no nuts, that one's totally safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊkənʌt mɪk noʊ nʌts ðæt wʌnz ˈtoʊɾəli seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 是椰漿做的，沒有堅果，那道完全安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, dessert is my favorite part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt dɪˈzɝt ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，甜點是我心中最美的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, same. One caution though, the cheesecake crust.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ seɪm wʌn ˈkɔʃən ðoʊ ðə ˈtʃizˌkeɪk kɹʌst/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我也是。不過要提醒，起司蛋糕的餅底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me guess, it has ground nuts in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛs ɪt hæz ɡɹaʊnd nʌts ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我猜猜，餅底裡有碎堅果，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a detective. Macadamia, so skip that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ə dɪˈtɛktɪv ˌmækəˈdeɪmiə soʊ skɪp ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你像大偵探。裡面是夏威夷豆，那道要跳過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll skip it sadly, mango rice for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ skɪp ɪt ˈsædli ˈmæŋɡoʊ ɹaɪs fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 雖然可惜但我跳過，甜點我要芒果糯飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice. Anything to drink tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tʃɔɪs ˈɛniθɪŋ tə dɹɪŋk təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。今晚要喝點什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just water, um, sealed bottle if you have it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈwɔɾɚ ʌm sil ˈbɑɾəl ɪf ju hæv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要礦泉水，嗯，有封瓶的那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sealed is safest, smart thinking.
dialogue.phonetic: /sild ɪz ˈseɪfəst smɑɹt ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 有封瓶的最安全，想得真周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'd be surprised what I learned on trips.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊd bi səpɹaɪzd wʌt aɪ lɝnd ɑn tɹɪps/
dialogue.zh: 你不會相信，我在旅行中學到多少事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bet. So the order's in, it's on track.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɛt soʊ ði ˈɔdɚz ɪn ɪts ɑn tɹæk/
dialogue.zh: 我肯定。餐點已經送進廚房，進度正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long for the curry, if that's okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ fɚ ðə ˈkɜɹi ɪf ðæts oʊkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 咖哩大概要等多久，方便說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wok wash adds ten minutes, fair warning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɑk wɑʃ ædz tɛn ˈmɪnɪts fɛɹ ˈwɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 洗鍋要多十分鐘，先跟你說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Totally fine, safety first, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli faɪn ˈseɪfti fɝst ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 完全沒問題，安全永遠第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly what we like to hear. Bread while you wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt wi laɪk tə hɪɹ bɹɛd ʍaɪl ju weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們最愛聽這種話。等餐時要麵包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, is the bread baked here?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ɪz ðə bɹɛd beɪkt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 要，請問麵包是在這裡烤的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, nut free kitchen, separate ovens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nʌt fɹi ˈkɪtʃən ˈsɛpɚɹət ˈʌvənz/
dialogue.zh: 是的，烤箱跟堅果廚房完全分開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You two are making this easy, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu ɑɹ ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðɪs ˈizi θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個讓我省心好多，真的感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, my manager will love hearing that.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪ ˈmænɪdʒɚ wɪl lʌv ˈhɪɹɪŋ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，經理聽到這句一定很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my water bottle just rolled off the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ maɪ ˈwɔɾɚ ˈbɑɾəl dʒʌst ɹoʊld ˈɔf ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我的水瓶剛從桌上滾下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll grab it, stay seated, it's just water.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ ɡɹæb ɪt steɪ ˈsitəd ɪts dʒʌst ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我撿就好，坐著別動，只是一瓶水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about that, it rolled so quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðæt ɪt ɹoʊld soʊ ˈkwaɪətli/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，它滾下去的時候一點聲音都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wobbly tables have a mind of their own, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑbli ˈteɪbəlz hæv ə maɪnd əv ðɛɹ oʊn ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，搖搖的桌子總像有自己的想法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, that table has a personal grudge against me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt ˈteɪbəl hæz ə ˈpɝsənəl ɡɹʌdʒ əˈɡɛnst mi/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那張桌子好像特別針對我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh bottle coming up, curry in two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹɛʃ ˈbɑɾəl ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp ˈkɜɹi ɪn tu ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 新的一瓶馬上來，咖哩再兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you both, chef and you, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju boʊθ tʃɛf ænd ju ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 真的，要好好謝謝你還有主廚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tell him, enjoy your peanut-free dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɫ tɛl hɪm ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔɹ ˈpinʌt fɹi ˈdɪnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我會轉達，請享用你的無花生晚餐。

script.youtube_title: 【泰式餐廳🍛】「桌子總像有自己的想法」花生過敏的晚餐點單🙋🎧｜聽完就敢確認成分｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Ordering Dinner with a Nut Allergy
script.youtube_title_en: "A Mind of Their Own" — Ordering Dinner with a Nut Allergy
script.youtube_description:
「桌子總像有自己的想法」——不過用餐過敏可不能開玩笑。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習：在泰式餐廳怎麼開口說明花生過敏，又把每一道菜問得清清楚楚。

你會聽到：點餐前的過敏聲明；請店員跟主廚雙重確認醬汁與炒鍋；沙拉上的杏仁片怎麼拿掉；甜點餅底藏著什麼；連水瓶滾落的小插曲，都有實用的安撫句與道歉句。

整段對話維持 A2 初級短句，語氣客氣卻清楚，是過敏者出國旅遊最需要的英語能力。聽完你就會用：Can you double check?、Anything else you'd like to avoid?、Safety first, always。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，把關鍵句子練成直覺。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡請訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Wobbly tables have a mind of their own" — but a food allergy is no joke. This episode is a 60-line immersive English listening practice: how to disclose a peanut allergy at a Thai restaurant and check every single dish.

You will hear: saying I have a serious peanut allergy before ordering; asking the waiter to double check with the chef about sauces and the shared wok; taking almond slices off a salad; spotting nuts hidden in a dessert crust; and easy apologies plus reassurance when a water bottle rolls off the table.

Everything stays in A2-level sentences, polite but clear — exactly the English travelers with allergies need most. By the end you'll own phrases like Can you double check?, Anything else you'd like to avoid?, and Safety first, always.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and train your safety English.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe and ring the bell for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
如果你對花生過敏，走進餐廳的第一句話該怎麼說？店員一句「我記得沒有」，夠不夠讓你安心？

這一集帶大家走進一家泰式餐廳，從座位上的第一句提醒、醬汁與炒鍋的逐項確認，一路聽到甜點、麵包與打翻水瓶的小插曲，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🥜 過敏聲明：I have a serious peanut allergy.
🍛 追問確認：Think? Can you double check with the chef?
🍰 甜點地雷：Let me guess, it has ground nuts in it.
💧 突發小意外：Oh no, my water bottle just rolled off the table.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 got it、one moment、no rush 這些自然回應唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這頓晚餐走一趟，下次站在櫃台前，你也能把安全問清楚。

祝你每一頓飯都吃得安心。
